explanation: The statement is a specific algebraic identity: η·(ηq)^(-1/2)·(3ηq/4)^(-1/2) = 2/(√3·q), with complex powers 1/2 of positive reals. The proof converts the complex powers to real square roots using Complex.ofReal_cpow and Real.sqrt_eq_rpow. It then uses the library's own real lemma eta_times_prefactor. Mathlib has the ingredients (ofReal_cpow, sqrt_eq_rpow), but I found no Mathlib lemma with this statement. I did not run a wide search, because the formula is specific to this development, and the conversion plus the real identity needs more than a two-line derivation from one Mathlib declaration.
